item.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketplace Economics - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic and causal insights that power pricing, market health, and creator success across all Economy surfaces.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the methodological and strategic foundations for our Creator Economics systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace to in-experience economies. You will build the economic systems and measurement frameworks that inform how value flows through the platform, such as building price optimization systems, designing new rev-share models, and establishing the economics for new UGC category launches. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical developer and creator touchpoints.
Why Marketplace Economics?
* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users. * **Complex markets, rich signals:** Design economic systems and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response. * **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions on the economics of our Marketplace. * **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.
You will:
* **Design Economic Systems**: Drive the structural design of creator and curator incentives, including formulating revenue-share models that foster a thriving, balanced ecosystem. * **Master Pricing & Supply Response**: Architect models that evaluate price elasticity, marketplace clearing rates, and predict how creators (supply) respond to pricing shifts and new economic policies. * **Spearhead UGC Category Launches**: Lead the quantitative strategy for introducing new User-Generated Content (UGC) categories, establishing the foundational economics and incentive structures needed to spark market liquidity. * **Apply Deep Causal Inference**: Build rigorous observational and experimental causal inference solutions to isolate the true impact of market interventions on creator success and platform economics. * **Drive Strategy**: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization.
You have (at least some of) the following:
* **6+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science or Economics, specifically within large-scale UGC content platforms, pricing, marketplace mechanism design, or creator economies. * **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL), alongside a deep theoretical understanding of econometrics and mechanism design. * **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health. * **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional economic problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences. * **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

item.title: Principal Data Scientist, Economy Recommendations - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science & Engineering organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic, causal, and algorithmic insights that power personalization, pricing, and content understanding across all Economy surfaces.
We are looking for a Principal Data Scientist to lead the measurement, strategic, and algorithmic foundations for our Economy Recommendation systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace where creators sell expressive items, to in-experience economies driven by developers. You will own the ranking initiatives that power these critical canvases. You will build the economic and social frameworks that decide which experiences and items thrive. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical consumer and developer touchpoints.
Why Economy Recommendations?
* **Real-world scale:** Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users. * **Complex surfaces, rich signals:** Design algorithms and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response. * **Strategic ownership:** Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions. * **Impact meets innovation:** Partner with ML Engineering and Product to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.
You will:
* **Set the Technical Direction:** Lead the development of retrieval and ranking solutions that power the Economy recommendation engine and surfaces.
* **Measure Long-Term Impact:** Build rigorous measurement and causal inference solutions to enable ranking models to optimize for long-term ecosystem health, creator growth, and platform economics rather than just short-term conversion. * **Drive Strategy:** Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization. * **Prototype & Productize:** Develop ranking prototypes to demonstrate what is possible, and partner closely with ML Engineering (MLE) to productize these solutions at scale. * **Elevate the Team:** Mentor and grow other data scientists on the team, create a culture of scientific excellence, and drive alignment on the long-term technical direction of the Economy space.
You have (at least some of) the following:
* **8+ years** of industry or research experience in Data Science, Economics, or ML Engineering, specifically within large-scale recommendation systems, pricing, or UGC content platforms. * **Deep Methodological Expertise** in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL, Hive, Spark, Airflow), along with a deep theoretical and practical understanding of Deep Learning. * **Marketplace Intuition** with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health. * **Executive Communication & Leadership** skills to distill high-dimensional problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences. You are a systems thinker and a deep collaborator who can initiate and facilitate challenging technical decisions across multiple teams. * **An Advanced Degree** (Master's or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

item.title: Applied Scientist, Search Ranking and Exploration - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Amazon's Search team creates ML algorithms that connect customers around the world with products that delight them. We harness machine learning at Amazon's scale to make the customer experience easier and smoother. Our impact is large. For example, if your innovations save even 1 minute per customer per year, then for every 100 million customers, you save approximately 190 years of human effort.
Key job responsibilities As an Applied Scientist on the Search L1 Ranking team, you will build search ranking models that work for thousands of product types, billions of queries, and hundreds of millions of customers spread around the world. You will find the next set of big improvements to ranking, leverage large datasets to understand the complexities of customer behavior, and build ML models that work at Amazon scale. Amazon's Search ranking relies on efficient early stage ranking followed by power final stage ranking models. this role focuses on efficient models for early stage ranking phase, and techniques to personalize these models and optimize them automatically.
A day in the life Our primary focus is improving search ranking systems. On a day-to-day this means building ML models, analyzing data from your recent A/B tests, and collaborating with partner teams on joint goals. We leverage agentic workflows to improve our scientific velocity, and partner closely with SDEs to bring our ideas to production. You will shape the future of search ranking by presenting proposals to Amazon's business and tech leaders.
About the team We are a team consisting of ML scientists and software engineers. Our interests span machine learned ranking models, distilled LLMs for efficient inference, personalization techniques to refine the ranking of our models, reinforcement learning to bring the benefits of exploration to search ranking, and infrastructure to make it all happen at scale and efficiently.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language * Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience using Unix/Linux * Experience in professional software development
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

item.description:

**What you'll do...** ---------------------

**Role summary****:**
The Staff, Data Scientist will leverage advanced analytical techniques and data science methodologies to deliver actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. This role involves identifying and validating data sources, developing predictive models, and deploying scalable solutions while ensuring data quality and governance standards. The position requires collaboration across functions to translate complex business challenges into data-driven solutions, utilizing expertise in machine learning, statistical analysis, and data visualization. The successful candidate will also mentor team members and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aligned with organizational goals.
**About the Team****:**
The **Global Fraud data science team** develops real-time and batch decisioning services using advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques to address fraud and risk within Walmart Inc. Focused on delivering a safe and seamless shopping experience, the team drives a proactive, outcome-oriented approach aligned with business goals. Emphasizing real-time decisioning, an adversarial mindset, and operational excellence through MLOps, the team leverages predictive analytics, data strategy, and artificial intelligence to optimize business value while maintaining robust frameworks that support continuous innovation and effective risk management.
**What you'll do****:**
* Identify and source relevant data from multiple business domains and distributed data stores to support analytics initiatives. * Perform data quality assessments and ensure data is fit for purpose in alignment with business requirements. * Develop and validate predictive models using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to address complex business problems. * Create clear and impactful data visualizations to communicate insights effectively to stakeholders. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data-driven solutions and strategies. * Deploy and monitor models in production environments, ensuring scalability and performance. * Mentor team members on analytical methods, coding best practices, and data storytelling.
**What you'll bring****:**
* **Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics**, or a related quantitative field **with 5+ years of relevant industry experience**, or a **Master's degree in a related quantitative discipline with 7+ years of experience architecting, building, and deploying machine learning solutions in production.** * Proficiency in predictive analytics, machine learning algorithms, and advanced statistical methods to develop and validate robust models. * Strong programming skills in Python and experience with data visualization tools such as Matplotlib, Plotly, or Tableau. * In-depth understanding of data strategy, including data quality standards, governance, and scalable data storage solutions. * Ability to translate complex business requirements into data-driven solutions and actionable insights. * Experience with exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model deployment in production environments. * Knowledge of database technologies including SQL and NoSQL for effective data sourcing and management. * Excellent communication skills to present technical findings clearly to business stakeholders.

We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. Walmart’s culture is a competitive advantage, and it’s fostered by being together. Working together in person allows us to collaborate, align quickly and innovate with greater speed. We use our campuses to create purposeful connection rooted in deepening understanding and investing in the development of our associates.
**Our hubs****:** Walmart is a global company with offices across the United States and around the world. Our global headquarters is in Bentonville, Arkansas, with primary hubs in the San Francisco Bay area and New York/New Jersey.
**Benefits****:** Benefits: Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include 401(k) match, stock purchase plan, paid maternity and parental leave, PTO, multiple health plans, and much more.
**Equal Opportunity Employer****:** Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers, and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

item.title: Data Scientist, Strategic Finance - Rippling
item.description:
**About Rippling** ------------------
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
**About the role** ------------------
As a Data Scientist on the Strategic Finance team at Rippling, you will combine advanced analytics, forecasting, and hands-on development of AI tools to inform company-wide business decisions. You will partner with stakeholders across Go-to-Market, Customer Experience, and R&D Finance to uncover insights and build forecasting models that shape financial targets and planning across Rippling’s product suites. You will also serve as an AI expert within Finance, building workflows and helping the team adopt new tools that fundamentally improve how it analyzes data and makes decisions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong analytical skills, business judgment, and a desire to shape how Finance works.
**What you will do** --------------------
* Lead analytics for company-wide planning cycles, partnering with Finance leaders to shape forecasts, financial targets, and resource allocation decisions * Drive the adoption of AI across Finance, combining hands-on development with coaching to transform how the team conducts analysis, generates insights, and makes decisions * Own automated forecasting models for key business metrics, including customer retention and expansion * Define and deeply understand critical business metrics such as net dollar retention and customer acquisition cost * Build high-quality data infrastructure to support accurate analyses of business performance across sales, marketing, R&D and customer experience * Serve as a trusted strategic partner to Rippling’s Finance executives, offering data-driven insights to support our continued strong ARR growth
**What you will need** ----------------------
* 4+ years of experience in data science and analytics – proven ability to use data science methods to drive business impact, particularly in B2B SaaS or fintech industries * Master’s degree or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, Econ, Math, Business Analytics, or other related fields * Proficiency in data analysis tools – hands-on experience with Python, SQL, dbt, Databricks, and other data analysis tools. You should be comfortable performing statistical analysis, running queries, and building models * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills –you will be expected to turn complex data into actionable insights that influence strategic business decisions * Curiosity and initiative to experiment with new AI tools and apply them to improve workflows * Strong communication skills – you should excel in communicating technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders * Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive projects end to end * Ability to operate autonomously in an ambiguous, fast‑paced environment
**Preferred qualifications include prior experience in** --------------------------------------------------------
* End-to-end model lifecycle, including development, backtesting, deployment, and monitoring * Time series forecasting with limited historical data * Financial modeling, gained through Strategic Finance, Investment Banking, or close partnership with Finance teams
**Additional Information** --------------------------
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.
A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.
**The pay range for this role is:** 120,000 - 190,000 USD per year(US Tier 1)

item.title: Sr Data Scientist - PayPal
item.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
**Job Summary:**
This job will lead the development and implementation of advanced data science models and algorithms. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists.
**Job Description:**
*PayPal, Inc. seeks Sr Data Scientist in San Jose, CA*
Job Duties: Develop, optimize, and execute data-driven strategies to identify, analyze, and manage payment disputes and chargebacks. Leverage large datasets to improve dispute resolution outcomes, minimize financial losses, and support operational effectiveness. item.description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. You'll help elevate the renter experience and protect millions of people by driving growth across our resident-facing offerings—including **FolioGuard renters' insurance, resident rewards programs, and comprehensive resident benefit packages**. You will partner with product, engineering, design, and other data scientists to solve challenging problems and propel one of our fastest-growing business areas to greater heights.
### **Your impact**
* **Optimize the resident journey:** Map, measure, and refine end-to-end enrollment and purchase funnels to drive measurable adoption of resident insurance, rewards, and benefit offerings. * **Scale experimentation rigor:** Build and implement standard causal inference and A/B testing frameworks that validate product hypotheses originated by both product teams and AI agents. * **Drive retention & sustained engagement:** Develop user behavioral segmentation models to uncover product-market fit signals, curb cancellations, and lift insurance renewal and benefit utilization rates. * **Accelerate analytical velocity with AI:** Integrate modern AI developer workflows (such as agentic coding assistants and pipeline automation) into team operations while establishing rigorous auditing and QA practices. * **Build reusable data assets:** Architect standard metric layers and cross-product analytical frameworks that serve as single sources of truth for resident adoption and financial metrics. * **Multiply team capabilities:** Elevate data science standards across the organization through active design/code reviews, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing on complex statistical problems.

### **Nice to Have**

item.title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Product Data Science (Mailchimp) - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
The Mailchimp Product Data Science team turns product and customer data into insights and models that shape Mailchimp's product strategy. We work as thought partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Pricing to drive data-driven decisions through experimentation, causal measurement, and deep customer analytics.
We're looking for a Senior Staff Data Scientist to be an analytical leader for Mailchimp's product growth. In this high-impact individual contributor role, you'll set the measurement vision across the full customer journey: sign-up and onboarding, activation, conversion to paid, engagement, and long-term retention. The role raises the scientific bar for how we experiment and size opportunities, and it shapes product and business strategy at the senior leadership level. It's also hands-on, focused on the highest-leverage problems and on helping the team adopt AI-native workflows that let us move faster.
This role is based in New York, NY / Mountain View, CA / Atlanta, GA under Intuit's hybrid model, 3 days per week in office.
**Responsibilities**
* **Influence product strategy:** Be a strategic thought partner to senior Product and business leaders. Shape Mailchimp's growth roadmap with deep dives into customer segmentation, onboarding and activation funnels, feature adoption, pricing and packaging, and retention. * **Set the analytics vision:** Own the measurement framework, north-star and guardrail metrics, and leading indicators for the self-serve customer journey, from free and trial sign-ups to paid conversion, bookings, and recurring revenue. * **Lead experimentation and causal measurement:** Drive a culture of rigorous, iterative experimentation. Design complex tests (A/B/n, sequential, holdouts, long-running), apply Bayesian and frequentist inference, and use causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, and synthetic control where randomized tests aren't possible. * **Size and prioritize opportunities:** Build opportunity-sizing and forecasting frameworks that turn product initiatives into incremental revenue impact, accounting for retention curves and the winner's curse, so leadership can prioritize investment. * **Uncover growth opportunities:** Use first-principles thinking and exploratory analysis to find untapped levers across the funnel, including in-product onboarding, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and plan upgrades. * **Shape the AI-native roadmap:** Partner with Product and Engineering to measure AI-powered features in Mailchimp. Build ML and LLM-based solutions such as propensity models, personalization, and automated insights for hard product problems. * **Raise the scientific bar:** Build reusable analytical frameworks, governed metric definitions, and self-serve tools that improve decision-making at scale. Champion strong instrumentation and data quality. * **Lead and mentor:** Be a technical lead for the Product Data Science team. Coach and grow senior and staff data scientists, review their methods, and model executive-ready storytelling.
**Qualifications**
* 8+ years in data science, product analytics, or a related field, with a proven record of driving product strategy and measurable business impact. * Experience in B2B SaaS, subscription, or freemium/self-serve businesses strongly preferred. Familiarity with marketing technology or small-business customers is a plus. * Expert SQL and data modeling skills on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery preferred), plus advanced Python or R. * Deep expertise in experimental design and causal inference, with the judgment to balance statistical rigor against speed of decision-making. * Track record of sizing opportunities and forecasting revenue impact, including funnel, cohort, and retention analysis. * Hands-on experience applying machine learning (classification, regression, uplift or propensity modeling) and LLM/GenAI workflows to real product problems. * Proficient in an AI-native data science tech stack (for example, Claude, Cursor, or Codex with MCPs, CLIs, and APIs) and eager to keep building how the team works with AI. * Excellent executive communication. You turn complex analysis into clear narratives and recommendations, and you've influenced senior leaders across Product, Marketing, and Finance. * Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional work where the question, metric definitions, or methodology have to be set before the analysis can start. * Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership of other data scientists. * Bachelor's or graduate degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Operations Research, or equivalent practical experience.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.
The expected base pay range for this position is:
New York $210,500 - $284,500

item.title: Staff Data Scientist - GoFundMe
item.description:
**Want to help us help others? We're hiring!**
GoFundMe is the world's most powerful community for good, dedicated to helping people help each other. By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe makes it easy and safe for people to ask for help and support causes, for themselves and each other. Together, our community has raised more than $40 billion since 2010.
We're looking for a **Staff Data Scientist** to help shape how GoFundMe uses data science to grow our impact across marketing, growth, and product. This role will serve as a senior individual contributor who leads high-impact workstreams across go-to-market and product surfaces, with a primary focus on helping the business make better decisions about audience strategy, acquisition, retention, personalization, experimentation, and investment efficiency.
You will partner closely with leaders across Data, Marketing, Product, Growth, Finance, and Engineering to define technical strategy, build scalable measurement and modeling frameworks, accelerate impact through modern AI-enabled workflows, and translate complex analyses into clear recommendations that improve outcomes for our users, customers, and business.
**Candidates considered for this role will be located in the San Francisco Bay Area.** **There will be an in-office requirement of 3x a week.**
**The Job**
* Lead high-impact data science initiatives across marketing, growth, and product, from problem definition through methodology, execution, interpretation, and recommendation. * Define org-level technical strategy, identify high-leverage opportunities, and establish best practices for experimentation, causal measurement, modeling, AI-assisted development, and decision science. * Design, analyze, and interpret experiments and quasi-experiments; build scalable frameworks to estimate incrementality, treatment effects, and long-term business value. * Develop ML, uplift, heterogeneous treatment effect, and adaptive experimentation models to improve targeting, segmentation, personalization, lifecycle optimization, audience strategy, budget allocation, and product decisions. * Partner with Marketing, Growth, Sales, Finance, and Product to evaluate acquisition, retention, ROI, user journeys, funnels, marketplace dynamics, donation conversion, and engagement. * Use AI tools to accelerate prototyping, analysis, coding, debugging, documentation, and repetitive workflows without compromising quality, accuracy, or review standards. * Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for technical, non-technical, and executive audiences. * Collaborate with Data, Analytics, and Product Engineering to improve instrumentation, data quality, experimentation infrastructure, and reusable data science workflows. * Mentor data scientists and analysts through design reviews, model reviews, methodology discussions, AI-enabled workflows, and shared best practices.
**You**
* 8+ years of experience leading data science, applied statistics, or machine learning projects with measurable business impact. * Master's degree or Ph.D. in a quantitative field, or equivalent applied experience coupled with a bachelor's degree. * Experience with marketing, growth, marketplace, and/or product optimization problems. * Strong command of statistical inference, causal inference, uplift modeling, heterogeneous treatment effects, treatment/control frameworks, and incrementality measurement. * Experience applying machine learning to targeting, personalization, segmentation, recommendation, lifecycle optimization, or similar problems. * Familiarity with adaptive experimentation, including frequentist A/B tests, multi-arm bandits, contextual bandits, and/or related optimization methods. * Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python for data extraction, transformation, modeling, and analysis. * Experience using AI-assisted tools to increase the speed and quality of analysis, coding, iteration, and communication. * Ability to define technical strategy, identify reusable patterns, and raise the quality of data science work across teams * Strong business judgment and stakeholder management skills. * Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including experience presenting to executive audiences. * Experience mentoring data scientists, analysts, or other technical team members.
**Preferred**
* Experience with marketing measurement methods such as media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, channel incrementality, forecasting, budget allocation, optimization, or ROI modeling. * Experience with web, mobile, product, or marketplace analytics tools such as Amplitude, Google Analytics, Optimizely, or GrowthBook. * Familiarity with modern data platforms and workflows such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Git, Looker, Tableau, or similar tools. * Experience operationalizing AI or ML workflows with engineering partners.
**Why you'll love it here**
* **Make an Impact**: Be part of a mission-driven organization making a positive difference in millions of lives every year. * **Innovative Environment**: Work with a diverse, passionate, and talented team in a fast-paced, forward-thinking atmosphere. * **Collaborative Team**: Join a fun and collaborative team that works hard and celebrates success together. * **Competitive Benefits**: Enjoy competitive pay and comprehensive healthcare benefits. * **Holistic Support**: Enjoy financial assistance for things like hybrid work, family planning, along with generous parental leave, flexible time-off policies, and mental health and wellness resources to support your overall well-being. * **Growth Opportunities**: Participate in learning, development, and recognition programs to help you thrive and grow. * **Commitment to DEI**: Contribute to diversity, equity, and inclusion through ongoing initiatives and employee resource groups. * **Community Engagement**: Make a difference through our volunteering program.
**We live by our core values:** *impatient to be great*, *find a way*, *earn trust every day*, *fueled by purpose*. Be a part of something bigger with us!
GoFundMe is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that actively pursues candidates of diverse backgrounds and experiences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, ethnicity, nationality or national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy status, marital status, age, medical condition, mental or physical disability, or military or veteran status.

item.title: Sr. Data Scientist, Assay Development - Delfi Diagnostics
item.description:
**About Us**
DELFI Diagnostics, Inc. (DELFI Diagnostics) is developing next-generation, blood-based tests that are reliable, accessible and deliver a new way to help detect cancer. Employing advanced machine-learning methods to whole-genome sequencing data, the DELFI ("DNA EvaLuation of Fragments for early Interception") platform is built to address the highest-burden health challenges. DELFI Diagnostics prioritizes solutions that have the potential to save lives on a global scale, including for historically underserved populations. DELFI Diagnostics’ platform relies on fragmentomics – the discovery that cancer cells are more chaotic than normal cells and, when they die, leave behind tell-tale patterns and characteristics of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) fragments. FirstLook Lung, for individuals eligible for lung cancer screening, is DELFI Diagnostics’ first laboratory-developed screening test and can be part of routine blood work. FirstLook Lung uses millions of data points to reliably identify individuals who may have cancer detected through low-dose CT, including early stage disease with a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent. This test has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.
In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:
**Lead with Science, Anchor in Pragmatism**: We pioneer life-changing science by ensuring quality, transparency, and rigor at all times. We explore thoughtfully, experiment smartly, and deliver impact with conviction.
**Build With & For All**: We embrace diverse backgrounds to innovate and achieve together. We are not just building a product - we aim to disrupt the path of cancer for all - no matter geography or socioeconomic class
**Put We over I**: We are a home for high-performing people. Through teamwork, we build collective intelligence. Each of us wins when those we serve and those who serve with us-win. We show up with empathy, humility, and integrity at every step of the journey.
**DELFI has 1-2 designated in-office working days each week for employees who live within within 50 miles of Palo Alto, CA**
### **About the Role**
The Senior Data Scientist will partner with assay development, lab operations, quality, regulatory, and software teams to support DELFI’s LDT and IVD early cancer detection assays as they move from late development into commercial use. The role focuses on study design and data analysis that keep our products performing reliably, including performance monitoring frameworks, change impact assessments, and bridging studies for LDT updates, as well as supporting verification and transfer to production. As products evolve, this person will also contribute to assay development work. The ideal candidate brings strong statistical foundations, experience in regulated diagnostics, and the ability to work independently across the later stages of the product lifecycle.
### **What You'll Do**
* Design studies and analyze data to evaluate assay performance and inform product decisions. * Develop statistical methods for production monitoring and for qualifying reagents, controls, and instruments across LDT and IVD products. * Assess the impact of reagent, instrument, software, and process changes, and design and analyze bridging studies for LDT updates. * Support verification and transfer to production for LDT and IVD products, including defining acceptance criteria. * Support regulatory submissions (CLIA/CAP, NYS, FDA as applicable) with rigorous, well-documented analyses. * Lead data analysis for troubleshooting, investigations, and root cause analysis, and contribute to assay development as products evolve. * Produce well-documented code (Python preferred, R acceptable) that meets quality system and software team standards.
### **What You'll Bring**
Required
* Master’s degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Math, Bioinformatics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; PhD preferred. * Five or more years of experience in scientific data analysis, including at least three years in Python or R (Python preferred). * Strong foundations in probability theory and statistics, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, parameter estimation, equivalence testing, and variance components. * Experience in a regulated diagnostics environment (IVD, LDT, or similar), including designing, analyzing, and documenting verification, validation, or change assessment studies. * Demonstrated ability to independently lead study design and analysis with cross-functional teams. * Ability to connect assay chemistry to data behavior to troubleshoot performance issues. * Familiarity with Design of Experiments and related quality methods (statistical process control, measurement systems analysis, Six Sigma/DMAIC).
Preferred
* Experience supporting launched assays, including production monitoring, lot qualification, or post-market changes. * Experience supporting assay transfer from development into production or a clinical laboratory. * Exposure to NGS-based assays, including sequencing QC and batch variability. * Familiarity with FDA design controls and IVD submissions.
$130,000 - $170,000 a year
Actual base pay will consider experience, skillset, education, and geography.
This role may be eligible for other forms of compensation, including an annual bonus and a new hire equity grant, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and Company discretion. All employees are also eligible for DELFI's comprehensive and competitive benefits package, including but not limited to: a flexible time-off policy; a 401(k) retirement plan; an extremely competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage; onsite lunch 3 days a week; and other wellness related offerings.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

item.title: Applied Scientist, Engineering - Anthropic
item.description:
**About Anthropic** -------------------
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
**About the role** ------------------
The Discovery team at Anthropic is organized around the north star goal of building an AI scientist – a system capable of solving the long-term reasoning challenges and basic capabilities necessary to push the scientific and technological frontier.
We're expanding our work on engineering and the applied sciences. Our goal is to contribute to training Claude to invent, design, and engineer across every discipline and scale, reliably and safely: new manufacturing and experimental techniques, processes, materials, devices, instruments, machines, energy systems, and factories. We want this work to accelerate science and technology and benefit people widely.
We're seeking exceptional researchers with deep expertise in one or more of these areas. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of frontier AI and your field, developing rigorous methods to measure and improve Claude's performance on complex engineering and scientific tasks. You'll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and partners across Anthropic and industry to build AI systems that can engage in all phases of research and development, and to test Claude's designs against real-world feedback.
**Key responsibilities** ------------------------

**Minimum qualifications** --------------------------
* Deep expertise and hands-on R&D or industry experience in an engineering or applied science discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, materials, chemical, aerospace, structural, industrial, or manufacturing engineering; applied physics; computational simulation * Experience with AI or machine learning, whether evaluating and training AI systems or applying these tools in your field * Track record of taking work from concept through to a working result, such as a product, process, device, experiment, or tool * Hands-on proficiency with the computational design, analysis, or simulation tools used in your field * Basic programming proficiency, for example in Python * Ability to navigate ambiguity and develop solutions in a rapidly evolving research environment * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and to explain your field clearly to people outside it * Commitment to using AI to accelerate engineering and scientific progress while maintaining high ethical standards

In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physic

item.title: Principal Data Scientist, User Ecosystem - Reddit, Inc.
item.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.
Reddit is a complex consumer ecosystem where users, content, communities, and conversations interact over time. We are looking for a very senior data science thought leader to shape how Reddit understands and improves that ecosystem for the user / consumer flywheel.
This role will define the measurement, modeling, and experimentation strategy for major Consumer questions: how users discover value, form habits, and deepen engagement; how we understand and serve user intent; how content and communities evolve; and how our systems create durable value for users, contributors, communities, and Reddit.
The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in one or more areas of consumer science, such as:
* Recommender systems and information retrieval * User modeling, personalization, lifecycle, LTV, or optimization * Content, community, or ecosystem modeling * Knowledge graphs and representations of users, content, and communities * Causal inference, experimentation, and long-term consumer measurement
You will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Research, and Community to turn ambiguous consumer problems into clear scientific questions, durable analytical systems, and decisions that improve Reddit at scale.
**What you'll do**
* Set the scientific direction for high-impact Consumer problems spanning discovery, relevance, personalization, user growth, retention, content, and communities. * Build a durable understanding of users, their intent, their needs, and the behaviors that lead to lasting value * Develop models and frameworks that represent users, content, communities, and their relationships over time for use in systems that operate at scale * Determine how to measure consumer and ecosystem health when objectives compete and short-term engagement may differ from long-term value. * Set learning agendas and steer experimentation strategy to distinguish durable improvement from temporary metric movement. * Build state-of-the-art measurement systems to evaluate heterogeneous effects across user personas, acquisition cohorts, platforms, content types, and community stages, and guide their actionability in production environments * Ensure coherence around ecosystem interactions including feedback loops, selection effects, interference, distribution shift, content supply, and other ecosystem risks. * Translate complex technical findings into clear product and business decisions. * Develop exceptional scientists through mentoring and influence data science org health and direction
**Requirements**
* Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, with the breadth and curiosity to work across adjacent domains. * A deep understanding of how to model and optimize systems involving users, content, communities, and feedback loops. * Ability to frame and lead the most ambiguous questions, identify the most important uncertainties, and develop a rigorous path from evidence to action. * Exceptional technical judgment across model design, objective selection, validation, experimentation, and production tradeoffs. * Advanced knowledge of modern machine-learning methods for behavioral and content data, including representation learning and sequential or contextual models. Experience with deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. * Experience working across Product, Engineering, Research, and other partner teams. * Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain technical ideas clearly. * Significant experience applying data science, machine learning, statistics, experimentation, or causal inference to complex consumer products.
**Pay Transparency:** This job posting may span more than one career level.
In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

item.title: Distinguished, Data Scientist - Walmart Global Tech
item.description:
Position Summary...
What you'll do...Walmart Ads is investing heavily in creative intelligence — the AI systems that generate, evaluate, understand, and continuously improve the ad creative advertisers use to reach customers, spanning static image and copy formats as well as video ads.
As a Distinguished Data Scientist, you will set technical direction for this space: building / leveraging generative models that produce high-quality ad assets at scale, the automated evaluation systems that judge and improve them, and the structured understanding of creative content that powers downstream targeting, measurement, and personalization.
About Team:
At Walmart Global Tech, the Walmart Ads Data Science team drives innovation in digital advertising by powering a fast-growing, multi-billion-dollar ads business across Sponsored Products, Display, and agentic buying experiences. The team builds the intelligence behind recommendations, bidding, and generative ad creative that help advertisers reach the right customers and grow their business on Walmart. Leveraging real-time signals, generative AI, and deep integration across Walmart’s advertiser and customer platforms, the team turns advertiser intent into measurable performance at scale.
What you'll do:
* Set the technical vision and roadmap for generative ad creative systems — producing images, copy, video and other ad assets that are high-quality, on-brand, compliant and performant at Walmart's advertiser scale. * Design and own automated systems that evaluate generated creative quality — using models to judge model output — including calibration against human/advertiser preference and defenses against common failure modes (distortion, hallucination, policy violations). * Build structured representations of creative content (attributes, categories, quality signals) that other teams can consume as reusable signals for targeting, recommendations, and performance measurement. * Drive advances in automated content composition and adaptation — combining computer vision and generative techniques to produce creative assets across many formats and placements without manual production effort. * Architect shared infrastructure — evaluation harnesses, generation pipelines, quality signals — so creative-AI capabilities compound across use cases instead of being rebuilt per project. * Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to translate ambiguous, evolving creative-product goals into a concrete, sequenced technical roadmap.
What you'll bring:
* 10+ years of applied ML/DS experience, with deep, hands-on expertise in generative AI (image generation, text generation, video generation or multi-modal generation) and computer vision * Proven experience designing automated model-evaluation systems (e.g., model-as-judge approaches) for generative output — including calibration, drift detection, and reliability at production scale. * Strong computer vision background — image understanding, composition, matching/cropping, or artifact/distortion detection. * A track record of taking generative ML systems from prototype to production at scale, with safety, moderation, and policy constraints designed in from the start. * Demonstrated technical leadership at Distinguished scope — setting direction across multiple workstreams, influencing without direct authority, and operating effectively amid ambiguous and evolving requirements. * Excellent communication skills; able to translate deep technical tradeoffs for senior product and business audiences.

item.title: Principal Data Scientist, Economy Recommendations - Roblox
item.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower a global community of creators and developers to build immersive experiences and a dynamic virtual economy. Our Data Science & Engineering organization sits at the heart of this mission, delivering the strategic, causal, and algorithmic insights that power personalization, pricing, and content understanding across all Economy surfaces.
We are looking for a Principal Data Scientist to lead the measurement, strategic, and algorithmic foundations for our Economy Recommendation systems. Roblox operates multiple two-sided marketplaces, from the Avatar Marketplace where creators sell expressive items, to in-experience economies driven by developers. You will own the ranking initiatives that power these critical canvases. You will build the economic and social frameworks that decide which experiences and items thrive. You will serve as a technical leader driving the roadmap for our most critical consumer and developer touchpoints.
Why Economy Recommendations?
* Real-world scale: Power millions of daily economic interactions across a complex, two-sided marketplace where millions of creators meet over 100 million daily active users. * Complex surfaces, rich signals: Design algorithms and measurement frameworks that account for the nuances of a two-sided marketplace, social network effects, long-term user attachment, and supply response. * Strategic ownership: Lead projects from scratch, translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks that directly influence high-stakes company decisions. * Impact meets innovation: Partner with ML Engineering and Product to shape the future of the Roblox economy, building measurement solutions that optimize for long-term ecosystem health and growth.
**You Will**
* Set the Technical Direction: Lead the development of retrieval and ranking solutions that power the Economy recommendation engine and surfaces. * Measure Long-Term Impact: Build rigorous measurement and causal inference solutions to enable ranking models to optimize for long-term ecosystem health, creator growth, and platform economics rather than just short-term conversion. * Drive Strategy: Partner with product and engineering leaders as a primary scientific advocate, providing unbiased measurement and insights to accelerate innovation and strategic prioritization. * Prototype & Productize: Develop ranking prototypes to demonstrate what is possible, and partner closely with ML Engineering (MLE) to productize these solutions at scale. * Elevate the Team: Mentor and grow other data scientists on the team, create a culture of scientific excellence, and drive alignment on the long-term technical direction of the Economy space.
**You Have (at Least Some Of) The Following**
* 8+ years of industry or research experience in Data Science, Economics, or ML Engineering, specifically within large-scale recommendation systems, pricing, or UGC content platforms. * Deep Methodological Expertise in quantitative methodologies, causal inference (observational and experimental), and modern data stack tools (Python, R, SQL, Hive, Spark, Airflow), along with a deep theoretical and practical understanding of Deep Learning. * Marketplace Intuition with a proven track record of working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behavior and isolate its impact on long-term outcomes and platform health. * Executive Communication & Leadership skills to distill high-dimensional problems into succinct, actionable narratives for non-technical executive audiences. You are a systems thinker and a deep collaborator who can initiate and facilitate challenging technical decisions across multiple teams. * An Advanced Degree (Master’s or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

item.description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
**Senior Data Scientist, EG Advertising** The Product Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business.
We're looking for a senior-level Data Scientist to provide deep analytics and decision support to the EG Advertising division to drive growth and achieve results for our travelers and partners.
In this role, you will partner closely with teams across Expedia Group and contribute to many aspects of product development, including auction optimisation, bidding mechanisms, measurement and incrementality.
**In This Role, You Will**
* Apply advanced statistical, analytical, and machine learning techniques to solve complex business and product problems, translating findings into measurable outcomes. * Design, build, and validate data models, experiments, and analytical solutions that inform product strategy, customer experiences, and operational decisions. * Partner with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to frame ambiguous problems, define success measures, and communicate actionable insights. * Develop scalable data science solutions across relevant domains, demonstrating technical fungibility and applying expertise to a range of products, services, and business challenges. * Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, while evaluating model performance, limitations, risks, and ongoing effectiveness. * Influence technical direction through rigorous analysis, data-driven decision making, and clear communication of complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. * Lead and mentor data scientists and engineers, fostering technical excellence and a culture of continuous learning. * Co‑own with Product and business leaders the metric frameworks and decision workflows for your area
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics, or a related quantitative field. * 5+ years of professional experience applying data science, statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning methods to real-world products or business problems. * Experience owning data science workstreams or solutions that span a product area, service, or multiple related business domains. * Strong programming and analytical skills, including experience with data modeling, statistical inference, experimentation, machine learning, and communicating insights through effective visualizations or other decision-support tools. * Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products. * You have demonstrated ability to mentor junior data scientists, balance speed, risk, and analytical rigor * You have experience with advanced visualization techniques / best practices, and building scalable dashboards
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s or doctoral degree in a quantitative discipline, or equivalent depth of applied data science experience. * Experience operating data science or machine learning solutions at scale, including monitoring performance, improving reliability, and translating model outputs into measurable product or business outcomes. * Demonstrated ability to shape analytical or machine learning architecture within a product, domain, or multi-service scope and to influence technical decisions across partner teams. * Strong operational and analytical discipline, including experiment design, metric development, model evaluation, and using data to guide prioritization under ambiguity. * Hands-on experience applying modern AI/ML approaches to production products, with the judgment to select appropriate methods, assess tradeoffs, and safely improve outcomes. * You have experience working in sophisticated e-commerce marketplaces and with advertising products
The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in Chicago is $161,000.00 to $225,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $257,500.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $187,000.00 to $261,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $299,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.
Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.
**Benefits And Perks** Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.
**Accommodation requests** Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
**About Expedia Group** Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
**Important notice** Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
**Equal Opportunity** Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This employer participates in E-Verify.
